web.title_en: Anthropic Research: IoT Networks May Host Self-Replicating AI Worms
web.description_en: This article highlights Anthropic's experimental proof that current advanced AI models can autonomously execute key steps such as scanning, exploitation, and payload deployment on low-cost IoT devices, marking the transition of 'AI worms' from theory to technical feasibility. Although currently limited by bandwidth and hardware, this research reveals the urgency for future defense systems to shift from countering threats at 'human speed' to combating automated attacks at 'machine speed'.

web.title: SAP Discloses Critical CVSS 10 Flaw in Cloud SDK for Python Allowing OAuth2 Credential Theft
web.description: A flaw in SAP's  Cloud SDK for Python  can send an application's OAuth2 client credentials to a server an attacker controls, SAP said in a  security advisory  on October 13. The flaw affects multi-tenant applications on SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) that use the SDK, SAP's official Python client for BTP services. An attacker must be able to control the tenant subdomain, the name such an application passes to the SDK to say which tenant a request is for.
